rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something lasting or happening throughout the night.

example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 maan5 dou1 mou5 fan3 gaau3

rows.note: Use this when an activity continues for the whole night, rather than merely being left until morning.

example.english: We played video games overnight last night.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 cam4 maan5 tung1 siu1 daa2 gei1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something occurring during the night.

example.jyutping: je6 maan5 ge3 hong4 baan1 tung1 soeng4 peng4 di1

rows.note: Use this for something arranged or completed during the night so it is ready by the next morning.

example.english: The overnight report is ready to send to the client tomorrow morning.
example.traditional: 隔夜嘅報告已經整好，聽朝交俾客。
example.jyutping: gaak3 je6 ge3 bou3 gou3 ji5 ging1 zing2 hou2 ting1 ziu1 gaau1 bei2 haak3

rows.note: Use this for a sudden change completed in a single night, especially the figurative “overnight” sense.

example.jyutping: gaan1 gung1 si1 jat1 je6 zi1 gaan1 hung4 zo2

rows.note: Use this when the people involved are required or expected to stay overnight.

example.english: This is an overnight camping trip, so remember to bring a sleeping bag.
example.traditional: 呢次係要過夜嘅露營活動，記得帶睡袋。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 hai6 jiu3 gwo3 je6 ge3 lou6 jing4 wut6 dung6 gei3 dak1 daai3 seoi6 doi6
